section.para: Stage 6 local-first registry and HTTP endpoints.

section.title: Scope
section.para: This chapter covers RegistryServer and RegistryClient APIs and staged HTTP features. Start with local, scriptable behavior before distributed deployment polish. RegistryStatus values should describe not-found and I/O failures clearly.

section.title: Client operations
section.para: deploy_http uploads a bundle to registry. download_http pulls package bundle by name. list_http fetches package list for inspection and automation.

section.title: Validation concerns
section.para: Treat malformed manifests or missing bundle files as explicit status failures. Log uploads/downloads with package name and version. Keep endpoint payloads stable and versioned.

literallayout.computeroutput: // Use a simple, scriptable registry format first. // Add auth and deployment polish after the basic flow works.

section.title: Health and listing
section.para: Provide a health endpoint to verify the registry is alive. Ensure package listings are deterministic so scripting is easy. Use small JSON payloads that are easy to inspect and test.

section.title: Chapter summary
section.para: A usable local registry closes the package distribution loop. Status-driven errors keep CLI and CI behavior predictable. Security hardening can build on this stable baseline.

literallayout.computeroutput: // Registry logic should stay transparent and script-friendly.
